subject: english-literature
title: Parallel Themes
welcome_lead: requires comparing texts. The HL Essay and Paper 2 thrive on parallel themes treated across different forms or cultures.
meta_desc: English Literature: comparative study, parallel themes across texts.
final_note: Comparison is not parallel summary — it is illuminating juxtaposition.

concepts.def: Analysis of two or more texts to illuminate similarities and differences.
A theme shared by multiple texts, providing the axis of comparison.
A specific angle or question used to align texts for analysis.
A meaningful difference between texts that sharpens understanding.
Points at which different texts arrive at similar insights.
Where similar themes are treated in opposing ways.

walkthroughs.body_html: Look for a theme distinctive enough to drive both texts — alienation in The Outsider and Notes from Underground — not so general it becomes vague (love, death).
A point of comparison might be: how each text uses an unreliable narrator to construct alienation. The narrower the point, the more incisive the analysis.
Devote roughly equal attention to each text. Avoid treating one as the 'main' text — the comparison itself should be the focus.

mcqs.q: Which is NOT a good axis for comparison?
options: A theme so broad it fits any text
A specific narrative technique
A shared cultural context
A genre convention
Parallel summary
Specific evidence
Direct quotation
Theoretical framing
Postmodernism just means literature written after modernism.
Self-aware metafiction, intertextuality, scepticism toward grand narratives, playfulness with form, and blurring of high/low culture.
Postmodernism means writing about the future.
A sonnet must always be exactly ten lines long.

mcqs.q: What is the structure of a Shakespearean sonnet?
options: A sonnet must always be exactly ten lines long.
Dystopian fiction predicts what will actually happen in 100 years.
A sonnet is any short love poem.
Fourteen lines in iambic pentameter, structured as three quatrains and a final couplet, rhyming ABAB CDCD EFEF GG, often with a volta near the couplet.

mcqs.q: What is the function of dystopian fiction?
options: Dystopian fiction predicts what will actually happen in 100 years.
Postmodernism means writing about the future.
To critique tendencies in the writer's own society by extrapolating them into a nightmarish future — dystopias hold up a warning mirror to the present.
Dystopian fiction is just storytelling set in scary futures.
